concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-paysafecard-recurring]] — 2026-09-15-captured PaySafeCard wallet-only recurring tokenization guide, with request flags, webhook token retrieval, subsequent ContAuth payments, data exchange and refusal handling; source distinguishes Voucher/PIN payment success from token creation.
warnings: Only myPaysafeCard wallet funding is token eligible; Voucher/PIN payment can process without a token, and the payment response does not identify funding source.
The country list and no-extra-setup claim are captured provider statements, not current merchant eligibility.
The 2004 error row is broken across raw lines 142–143; keep lower-amount retry or shopper top-up as the two listed paths.
